nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex Banach space, let $R$ be a rectilinear rectangle and let $f : \mathbb{C} \to E$ be complex differentiable on the closed rectangle spanned by the corners of $R$ (the carrier of $R$). Then the boundary integral of $f$ over $R$ is $0$.

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a rectilinear rectangle and let $w$ be a complex number that does not lie in the closed rectangle spanned by the corners of $R$ (the carrier of $R$). Then the boundary integral of $z \mapsto 1/(z - w)$ over $R$ is $0$.

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex Banach space, let $f : \mathbb{C} \to E$ and let $x_0, x_1, y_0, y_1, y_2$ be real numbers such that the maps $y \mapsto f(x_0 + iy)$ and $y \mapsto f(x_1 + iy)$ are continuous on $\mathbb{R}$. For real $a, b, c, d$ write $R(a, b, c, d)$ for the rectangle with corners $a + ic$ and $b + id$. Then the boundary integral of $f$ over $R(x_0, x_1, y_0, y_2)$ equals the sum of the boundary integrals…

nodes.summary: Let $a, b, T$ be real numbers with $a < 0 < b$ and $T > 0$. Then the boundary integral of $z \mapsto 1/z$ over the rectangle with corners $a - iT$ and $b + iT$ equals $2\pi i$.
nodes.title: Rectangle integral of $1/z$ around the origin

nodes.summary: Let $x_0, x_1, y_0, y_1$ be real numbers and let $w$ be a complex number with $x_0 < \operatorname{Re} w < x_1$ and $y_0 < \operatorname{Im} w < y_1$. Then the boundary integral of $z \mapsto 1/(z - w)$ over the rectangle with corners $x_0 + iy_0$ and $x_1 + iy_1$ equals $2\pi i$.
nodes.title: Rectangle integral of the Cauchy kernel at an interior point

nodes.summary: For all real numbers $x_0, x_1, y_0, y_1$ and every complex number $w$, the boundary integral of $z \mapsto 1/(z - w)$ over the rectangle with corners $x_0 + iy_0$ and $x_1 + iy_1$ equals the boundary integral of $z \mapsto 1/z$ over the rectangle with corners $(x_0 - \operatorname{Re} w) + i(y_0 - \operatorname{Im} w)$ and $(x_1 - \operatorname{Re} w) + i(y_1 - \operatorname{Im} w)$.
nodes.title: Translating the Cauchy kernel to the origin

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex Banach space, let $f : \mathbb{C} \to E$ and let $x_0, x_1, x_2, y_0, y_1$ be real numbers such that the maps $x \mapsto f(x + iy_0)$ and $x \mapsto f(x + iy_1)$ are continuous on $\mathbb{R}$. For real $a, b, c, d$ write $R(a, b, c, d)$ for the rectangle with corners $a + ic$ and $b + id$. Then the boundary integral of $f$ over $R(x_0, x_2, y_0, y_1)$ equals the sum of the boundary integrals…

nodes.summary: For an axis-parallel rectangle with opposite corners $z$ and $w$, its carrier is the closed rectangle of all $u \in \mathbb{C}$ such that $\operatorname{Re} u$ lies in the closed interval with endpoints $\operatorname{Re} z$ and $\operatorname{Re} w$, and $\operatorname{Im} u$ lies in the closed interval with endpoints $\operatorname{Im} z$ and $\operatorname{Im} w$.
nodes.title: Carrier of an axis-parallel rectangle

nodes.summary: Let $G \subseteq \mathbb{C}$. A rectilinear cycle $\Gamma$, read as a filling by rectangles, is supported in $G$ when, for every rectangle $r$ whose coefficient in $\Gamma$ is nonzero, the closed carrier of $r$ is contained in $G$.
nodes.title: Rectangle filling supported in a set

nodes.summary: Let $G \subseteq \mathbb{C}$. Two rectilinear cycles $\Gamma$ and $\Lambda$ are homologous in $G$ when the rectangle filling of $\Gamma - \Lambda$ is supported in $G$: every rectangle with nonzero coefficient in $\Gamma - \Lambda$ has its closed carrier contained in $G$.
nodes.title: Rectilinear cycles homologous in a set

nodes.summary: Let $a \le b$ and $T \ne 0$ be real numbers. Then $\int_a^b \frac{dx}{x - iT} - \int_a^b \frac{dx}{x + iT} = 2i\left(\arctan\frac{b}{T} - \arctan\frac{a}{T}\right)$.
nodes.title: Difference of horizontal integrals of the reciprocal

nodes.summary: For a rectilinear cycle $\Gamma$ and a point $w \in \mathbb{C}$, the index of $\Gamma$ about $w$ is $\frac{1}{2\pi i}\int_\Gamma \frac{dz}{z - w}$, the contour integral over $\Gamma$ of $z \mapsto (z - w)^{-1}$, multiplied by $(2\pi i)^{-1}$.
nodes.title: Index of a rectilinear cycle

nodes.summary: For a fixed point $w \in \mathbb{C}$, the map sending a rectilinear cycle $\Gamma$ to its index about $w$ is an additive group homomorphism from rectilinear cycles to $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Winding index as an additive map

nodes.summary: For an axis-parallel rectangle $r$ and a point $w \in \mathbb{C}$ outside the closed carrier of $r$, the index about $w$ of the cycle consisting of the boundary of $r$ is $0$.
nodes.title: Rectangle index vanishes outside the rectangle

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex Banach space and $f : \mathbb{C} \to E$. The map sending a rectilinear cycle $\Gamma$ to the contour integral of $f$ over $\Gamma$ is an additive group homomorphism from rectilinear cycles to $E$.
nodes.title: Contour integration as an additive map

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex Banach space and $f : \mathbb{C} \to E$. For rectilinear cycles $\Gamma$ and $\Lambda$, the contour integral of $f$ over $\Gamma + \Lambda$ equals the integral of $f$ over $\Gamma$ plus the integral of $f$ over $\Lambda$.
nodes.title: Additivity of the contour integral in the cycle

nodes.summary: For real numbers $a$, $b$ and $d$ with $d \ne 0$, $\int_a^b \frac{d}{x^2 + d^2}\,dx = \arctan\frac{b}{d} - \arctan\frac{a}{d}$.
nodes.title: Arctangent integral

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex Banach space, let $G \subseteq \mathbb{C}$, and let $f : \mathbb{C} \to E$ be complex differentiable on $G$. If $\Gamma$ and $\Lambda$ are rectilinear cycles that are homologous in $G$, that is, the closed rectangle of every rectangle occurring in $\Gamma - \Lambda$ with nonzero coefficient is contained in $G$, then the contour integral of $f$ over $\Gamma$ equals the contour integral of $f$…
nodes.title: Homologous rectilinear cycles have equal integrals

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex Banach space, let $G \subseteq \mathbb{C}$, and let $f : \mathbb{C} \to E$ be complex differentiable on $G$. If $\Gamma$ is a rectilinear cycle whose rectangle filling is supported in $G$, that is, the closed rectangle of every rectangle occurring in $\Gamma$ with nonzero coefficient is contained in $G$, then the contour integral of $f$ over $\Gamma$ is $0$.
nodes.title: Cauchy–Goursat theorem for rectilinear cycles

nodes.summary: For every rectilinear cycle $\Gamma$, every complex Banach space $E$ and every function $f : \mathbb{C} \to E$, the contour integral of $f$ over $-\Gamma$ is the negative of the contour integral of $f$ over $\Gamma$.
nodes.title: Reversing a cycle negates its integral

nodes.summary: For rectilinear cycles $\Gamma$ and $\Lambda$, a complex Banach space $E$ and a function $f : \mathbb{C} \to E$, the contour integral of $f$ over $\Gamma - \Lambda$ equals the contour integral of $f$ over $\Gamma$ minus the contour integral of $f$ over $\Lambda$.
nodes.title: Integral over a difference of cycles

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complex Banach space and $f : \mathbb{C} \to E$. For a rectilinear cycle $\Gamma$, a finite formal sum $\sum_r n_r\, r$ of rectangles $r$ with integer coefficients $n_r$, the contour integral of $f$ over $\Gamma$ is $\sum_r n_r \int_{\partial r} f$, where $\int_{\partial r} f$ is the boundary integral of $f$ over the oriented rectangle $r$.
nodes.title: Contour integral over a rectilinear cycle

nodes.summary: If $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfies $f(-x) = -f(x)$ for every real $x$, then $\int_{-T}^{T} f(x)\,dx = 0$ for every real $T$.
nodes.title: Integral of an odd function over a symmetric interval

nodes.summary: For real numbers $x_0, x_1, y_0, y_1$, this is the rectilinear rectangle whose first corner is $x_0 + i y_0$ and whose second corner is $x_1 + i y_1$.
nodes.title: Rectangle with given coordinate bounds

nodes.summary: For a rectilinear rectangle $r$, this is the rectilinear cycle in which $r$ has coefficient $1$ and every other rectangle has coefficient $0$, that is, the boundary of $r$ with the orientation given by its corner order.
nodes.title: The cycle of a single rectangle

nodes.summary: A rectilinear cycle is a finitely supported function from rectilinear rectangles to $\mathbb{Z}$, that is, a finite formal sum $\sum_r n_r\, r$ of rectilinear rectangles $r$ with integer coefficients $n_r$, read as the corresponding integer combination of oriented rectangle boundaries.
nodes.title: Rectilinear cycle

nodes.summary: A rectilinear rectangle is an axis-parallel rectangle in the complex plane, recorded by an ordered pair of complex numbers $z$ and $w$, its first and second corner, which are opposite corners of the rectangle.
nodes.title: Rectilinear rectangle

nodes.summary: For real numbers $c \ne 0$ and $T \ge 0$, $\int_{-T}^{T} \frac{1}{c + iy}\,dy = 2\arctan(T/c)$, where the integrand is complex valued and the integral is taken over the real variable $y$.
nodes.title: Integral of $1/(c + iy)$ over a symmetric interval

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
